name: Onfleet
label: Onfleet REST v2 — tasks, destinations, workers
description: onfleet.com/api/v2. HTTP Basic with api_key as username and empty password (auth.basicKeyPosition=username). Driver/recipient PII — do not log. trigger is ingress. Docs: https://docs.onfleet.com/reference/authentication
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: task_create | task_get | task_update | destination_create | worker_list | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: taskId
schema.description: Onfleet task id for task_get / task_update. Example: ~2JTzU1TqPqJ6k7a.

schema.label: states
schema.description: worker_list filter. Comma-separated worker states: 0=off, 1=idle, 2=active. Example: 1,2.

schema.label: teams
schema.description: worker_list filter. Comma-separated team ids.

schema.label: phones
schema.description: worker_list filter. Comma-separated E.164 phones. Example: +15551234567.

schema.label: destination
schema.description: task_create destination: existing id string or Destination object. Official: {"address":{"unparsed":"543 Howard St, San Francisco, CA, USA"}}. Required for task_create.

schema.label: recipients
schema.description: task_create recipients: zero or one recipient id or Recipient object. Example: [{"name":"Jane Doe","phone":"+15551234567"}].

schema.label: notes
schema.description: Task or destination notes. Max 10000 chars on tasks. Used by task_create, task_update, destination_create.

schema.label: completeAfter
schema.description: Earliest completion time, Unix ms. task_create / task_update. Example: 1735689600000.

schema.label: completeBefore
schema.description: Latest completion time, Unix ms. task_create / task_update.

schema.label: pickupTask
schema.description: Whether the task is a pickup. task_create / task_update. Example: false.

schema.label: merchant
schema.description: Organization id shown to the recipient (task_create).

schema.label: executor
schema.description: Organization id that fulfills the task (task_create).

schema.label: quantity
schema.description: Drop-off units for routing (task_create / task_update).

schema.label: serviceTime
schema.description: Minutes on site for routing (task_create / task_update).

schema.label: autoAssign
schema.description: Automatic assignment options for task_create. Do not send with container.

schema.label: container
schema.description: Container to append the task to (task_create). Official: {"type":"WORKER","worker":"<id>"}.

schema.label: metadata
schema.description: Task metadata array [{name, type, value}] for task_create / task_update.

schema.label: address
schema.description: destination_create address. Official: {"unparsed":"543 Howard St, San Francisco, CA, USA"} or {"number","street","city","state","postalCode","country"}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: task_create | task_get | task_update | destination_create | worker_list | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Onfleet API key. HTTP Basic username with empty password (auth.basicKeyPosition=username). Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
